summary: Iteration 3: tested new CoinSwitch PRO Futures WS feed telemetry + regression + frontend FeedHealthStrip. 9/9 pytest passed (backend/tests/test_backend_iter3_feed.py). /api/telemetry.feed reports source=COINSWITCH_WS, laggard.connected=true, subscribed=true, wire_latency_ms~120, msgs_per_s~42, all 10 coins fresh (age_ms<500), leader.coins_with_quotes=10, rest_fallback={available:false,active:false}. Spreads confirm INR-scaled CSW quotes ~= binance*fx (within 3%), 10 items, ask>=bid, small gross_spread_pct. Stop->Start cycle: feed recovers to COINSWITCH_WS within ~2-3s. LIVE-mode toggle returns response mentioning missing keys; restored to PAPER. Bot left RUNNING in PAPER mode. Frontend renders laggard-feed-health-strip with all required badges and 10 coin chips; no simulator/rest-fallback badges; header WS LIVE + MODE PAPER; 10 spread cards with non-zero CSW bids; no console errors.
passed: GET /api/telemetry.feed shape (source, laggard connected/subscribed/wire_latency/msgs_per_s/coins x10 all fresh, leader 10/10, rest_fallback disabled)

No feed-simulator-badge and no feed-rest-fallback-badge (correct given real-WS + no keys)
10 spread-slot-card-* cards render with non-zero CSW bid values
Zero console errors during dashboard load
critical_code_review_comments: FeedHealthStrip msg-rate badge uses same green color as WS-connected — consider a muted variant to visually rank badges by importance.
Consider surfacing feed.laggard.last_error to the dashboard (data-testid=feed-last-error exists but only rendered on error); add a subtle 'clean' indicator to avoid layout jump when error appears.
/api/config exposes 'simulate' but no explicit 'simulate_market'; consider renaming for consistency with backend/.env key SIMULATE_MARKET.
